question: In December 2021, Aanchal Thakur was in news for winning a bronze medal at an international event. Which sport is she associated with?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Alpine Skiing.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aanchal Thakur **is associated with the sport of** Alpine Skiing.**
 
• She won a** bronze medal** at the** Alpine Ejder 3200 Cup** held in **Turkey **in **December 2021.**
 
• Aanchal Thakur is the first Indian to win an **international medal in skiing.**
 
• She hails from a small village in **Himachal Pradesh** and has been **skiing **since the age of four.
 
• Aanchal Thakur has faced **several challenges and financial constraints** in pursuing her passion for skiing, but her determination and hard work have paid off.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biathlon** is a **winter sport **that combines **cross-country skiing and rifle shooting.**
 
• **Billiards** is an** indoor cue sport** played on a table with **six pockets and a cue stick.**
 
• **Figure skating** is a sport in which individuals, pairs, or groups perform s**pins, jumps, and other moves** on ice using skates.
